title: It is a great initiative if it is well executed
text:
This review is based just on the first two months, I will update it as I receive more packages...

So far I have mixed feelings, the first month I was really disappointed but I really like the package we have just received, technically it should be a 3.5 but I'm giving it a 4 having the hope that the problems with the first one won't repeat

The idea for the club is great, first because doing group orders they can offer items that are more expensive just for the group fee, but second because they can curate the contents and expose us and our children to things we don't know and can help in their development. I hope they continue trying to provide good quality products to make the club worth it

2nd Month: (*****)
Good STEM toy, it is a construction kit that encourages thinking for problem solving and also is generic enough that kids can explore and create their own inventions. Good toy value for the price of the club's subscription
You can see my review for it in the product page:
[[ASIN:B00TF8ZF94 Kids First Automobile Engineer Kit]]

------------

1st Month: (**)
I have to say that I'm not a fan of the surprise chest as usually you get the items that it is difficult to sell in other ways, but being Amazon I was expecting more from this. The first item I got is sold right now for $25 but I wouldn't pay more than $5 for it. You can see my review for it in the product page:

[[ASIN:B01GBINE3O The Learning Journey Count & Learn Math Playbox]]

Amazon, please, we know you can do much more with this club, it is a great initiative if it is well executed, don't disappoint us!

------------

Seeing the great improvement in the second month it looks like our comments have been useful, thanks Amazon for listening and always trying to improve
label: positive
